training: 24 independent checked programs; identical frozen corpus available through identical deterministic retrieval to all methods. GEPA extra policy-search compute reported separately, not disguised as free. One-reflection strong simpler control also sees whole corpus.
test: 56 previously uninspected tasks across seven library-based families. The time-only family has 5 eligible tasks and no remaining held-out members; no broad temporal-skill claim.
per_job: same hosted model, 2 calls at most, 2400 output tokens each, same smoke-check executor and same training evidence; terminal test hidden until ALL methods commit proposals
primary: All frozen 56 tasks remain in the denominator. Reference-program failures are separately reported; no replacement tasks.
success_rule: positive accuracy difference and one-sided exact paired p <= .025 against BOTH controls; no family loses more than one task
public_benchmark_limit: Externally authored tasks, freshly held out from this experiment, not necessarily unseen during model pretraining; performance is not proof of novel algorithmic or neural superiority.
runtime: Python3.14, enrolled installed packages only, native macOS sandbox no network/home files and fresh writes; no unsandboxed fallback
reproducibility: retain exact code, checks, source and prompt hashes, attempts, outcome journal, policy lineage and configured-rate costs; independent executable replay without a model
input_specification: The pinned complete_prompt, including parameters, return types and examples, is supplied identically to every method. No canonical_solution or checker text is sent to the model.
